summary: Strengthen advanced SPSS analysis, diagnostics, and reporting skills. Review the five-day course outline and see whether it fits your work.
lede: SPSS advanced statistics helps research analysts and other professionals who already use SPSS examine complex datasets beyond routine summaries and basic tests. The course develops skills in screening missing data and checking assumptions, selecting and interpreting GLM procedures such as ANCOVA and MANOVA, and applying repeated-measures or nonparametric tests. You also practise reproducible SPSS Syntax and communicating effect sizes and multiple comparisons in clear reports.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who already use SPSS Statistics and need to extend their analysis beyond routine descriptive and inferential procedures. It is designed for roles that select methods, review assumptions, interpret model output, or communicate statistical findings.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of descriptive statistics, hypothesis testing, and routine IBM SPSS Statistics use. Programming is not required. Bring a laptop with licensed IBM SPSS Statistics access and a de-identified dataset you are permitted to analyze.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
